run_ppo_training: run PPO training on StarCraft2 SMAC environment with configurable workers and map name
register_smac_env: register the SMAC StarCraft2 environment with RLlib using RLlibStarCraft2Env
register_masked_model: register the MaskedActionsModel as a custom model in the RLlib ModelCatalog
configure_ppo_experiment: configure a PPO experiment with shared value layers and no observation filter
run_ray_experiments: run Ray Tune experiments for PPO on SMAC with specified training iterations
